note: Majority and work weren't read: the Register of Legal Acts (e-tar.lt) and the Seimas's legal database (e-seimas.lrs.lt, www3.lrs.lt, every format endpoint tried) answered this client with a Cloudflare 'Just a moment' check, as did the Ministry of Social Security and Labour (socmin.lrv.lt), the State Labour Inspectorate (vdi.lt) and Infolex; archive.org held no snapshot of the Civil Code's e-seimas page and its servers dropped every connection on 2026-10-31. Both are left null (the Civil Code, article 2.5, and the Labour Code, articles 22 to 23, are where they would be read). Service: the Law on Military Service as amended by the Seimas on 13 June 2024 (85 votes for), in force from 1 January 2026, as LRT (the national broadcaster) reports it from the Seimas and BNS: men aged 18 to 22 are called for compulsory initial military service, which lasts nine months; 17-year-olds on the conscription list must report and have a health check; voluntary service is open to 39. Women aren't conscripted (the law calls 'young men'). The Armed Forces' own pages (kariuomene.lt, karys.lt) refused this client behind Cloudflare, so the law's text wasn't read. A headline on LRT's pages a day old on 2026-10-31 (not read) says universal conscription is to come in 2032; not modelled.

sources.title: LRT: Lithuanian parliament adopts conscription reform (13 June 2024)
sources.said: Under the new law, young men aged 18 to 22 will be drafted after school.
